title_zh: 输给游戏里的智能对手
title_en: Artificial Intelligence (19/20): Beaten by an AI Opponent
note_en: A不如B means "A is not as good as B": 他发现自己的反应速度远不如对手 "he realizes his reactions are nowhere near as fast as his opponent's." Unlike 比, it needs no adjective, and 远 in front makes the gap big. The text also uses 不如 to recommend a better option: 不如先专注于提升基础操作的稳定性 "he'd do better to first focus on his basic moves," much like English "might as well" or "would be better off."
